dict.string: NotchMac analyzes audio from your music app to draw a real-time waveform in the notch. Audio is processed locally and never leaves your Mac.
NotchMac shows your upcoming events in the notch.
NotchMac shows your upcoming events in the notch and lets you glance at calendar details without leaving your current app.
NotchMac shows your reminders in the notch.
NotchMac shows your reminders in the notch and lets you mark them complete from the dashboard.
NotchMac uses contacts to show attendee names on calendar events.
